patch.value: Extend native list selection to configured lifecycle and hierarchy registries

Follow-up to the built-in list pagination slice. Native selection currently uses canonical lifecycle and parent/child relationship kinds. Add configured status buckets, terminal classification and custom hierarchy kinds using real disposable-tracker differentials against the pinned oracle. Preserve page fingerprints and full JSON/TOON envelopes.

Configured status and hierarchy definitions produce identical selected rows, sorting, fingerprints and multi-page JSON/TOON envelopes to the pinned oracle; preserve all four 100 percent coverage dimensions

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The locked oracle resolves custom hierarchy kinds through extension registration, with no persisted definition format. Native selection reads a declarative schema.relationship_kinds snapshot using the oracle definition fields (kind, aliases, hierarchy, hierarchyDirection). Disposable oracle trackers activate a real schema extension registering those same definitions. No JavaScript is executed by native production code; arbitrary extension activation remains outside this slice.

The independent oracle read gap is tracked in pm-rust-tdps. Custom status fingerprints also retain projectionCommand=list, excludeTerminal and the raw status semantic option, matching the oracle rather than inventing a list-custom-status command.
